title: Project website and documentation
detail: Overview, package guides, verified progress and a roadmap in one place.

title: Reusable Effect runtime
detail: Lazy effects, typed failures, resources, services, concurrency and streams.

title: PostgreSQL and MySQL integrations
detail: Established Dart drivers, scoped connections, transactions and real database acceptance.

title: OpenAI SDK integration
detail: Typed requests, Responses and Chat streams, scoped clients and local HTTP/SSE acceptance.

title: Live OpenAI Responses smoke acceptance
detail: Two native live Responses streams passed with text, Unicode, terminal completion and awaited cleanup through user-authorized ChatGPT plan access.

title: First pub.dev release
detail: The initial five packages were published, followed by effect_http. Six published releases remain distinct from the thirteen unpublished toolkit additions.

title: OpenAI performance and bounded retention evidence
detail: Repeated native AOT comparisons against direct openai_dart, VM post-GC owner checks, and macOS Flutter profile runs. Measurable adapter overhead and remaining live/mobile limits are documented.

title: Core and SQL performance and bounded retention
detail: Dated core JIT/AOT comparisons, portable SQL overhead, real PostgreSQL/MySQL driver timings, repeated post-GC owner checks and bounded 30-second load runs. Measurable overhead and production limits are recorded. These measurements predate the toolkit implementation.

title: Production database acceptance
detail: Trusted CA chains and bounded load/retention checks passed for both drivers. Connection loss, proxy network interruption, long production soak and version coverage remain open.
dependency: A reproducible database version matrix and isolated TLS/failover test environments.
acceptance: Record PostgreSQL and MySQL CA verification, interrupted transactions, failover, network partitions and soak results, including cleanup and rollback outcomes.

tasks.title: Trusted CA chains and hostname verification

title: Broader OpenAI live acceptance
detail: Other API endpoints, live browser transport, load/soak and failure injection remain unverified. ChatGPT plan access covers only eligible Responses requests.
dependency: An API-enabled test account and a server-side credential are required; ChatGPT subscription access is not general API coverage.
acceptance: Record successful and failed live requests for supported endpoints, browser transport through a safe test backend, cancellation and bounded load/soak; retain endpoint-specific evidence.

title: Runnable API and Flutter integration guides
detail: Show application-owned runtimes, shared service layers, safe read retry, SQL transactions and server-side OpenAI access.
dependency: Existing released packages; a Flutter device target for native acceptance.
acceptance: Run the API example and Flutter lifecycle journey, including owner shutdown and interruption; publish commands and platform-specific results.

title: Typed configuration, schemas and cache foundations
detail: Initial foundations exist in draft PR #13. Twelve packages remain outside the cache merge-ready checkout; historical tests do not mean they are ready to merge.
dependency: Finish each package independently; keep draft PR #13 open.
acceptance: Merge only individually completed package PRs with their own validation.

title: Advanced runtime, streams and schedule contracts
detail: Development core adds graceful queue completion, replay policies and bounded ordered stream operators. Region-wrapper stack safety, restoration/supervision, generated dependency evidence, stream merge/time/recovery/leftovers and calendar schedules remain open.
dependency: Prioritize operators from actual application needs and define backpressure and cancellation contracts.
acceptance: Independent bounded-buffer, early-exit, interruption and exactly-once cleanup scenarios for each advertised operator.

title: Complete tracing and exporter integrations
detail: Development effect_observability provides bounded metrics, Prometheus text, traceparent and explicit exporter lifecycle. OTLP, a complete span model, fiber-local propagation and instrumentation overhead remain open.
dependency: Select Dart observability interfaces and decide privacy, overhead and exporter boundaries.
acceptance: Verify successful/failed/interrupted spans, scoped exporter cleanup and measured overhead.

title: Native Flutter and broader platform acceptance
detail: Development Flutter controllers passed widget tests and one-shot isolates passed native tests. Physical-device journeys, stream bindings, worker pools and browser workers remain open.
dependency: Define ownership and supported platform contracts; choose real device acceptance targets.
acceptance: Run native Flutter disposal journeys and isolate sendability/error propagation tests; record unsupported platforms.

title: Reliability policies and HTTP/SSE integration
detail: Core 0.0.2 retains timeout cleanup diagnostics and adds typed retries, capped/Retry-After schedules, independent jitter, elapsed budgets, lifecycle tracing/metrics, circuit breakers and admission spacing. Optional effect_http 0.0.1 provides abortable HTTP and bounded SSE. Verified by 230 VM and 184 Chrome checks; live browser cancellation and enabled-tracing performance remain open.

title: Thirteen application toolkit package foundations
detail: Initial foundations exist in draft PR #13. Twelve packages remain outside the cache merge-ready checkout; historical tests do not mean they are ready to merge.
dependency: Finish each package independently; keep draft PR #13 open.
acceptance: Merge only individually completed package PRs with their own validation.

title: Toolkit API breadth and release preparation
detail: Remaining schema derivation, provider bridges and AI acceptance, PostgreSQL/MySQL migrations, server streaming/OpenAPI and advanced batching/cache APIs remain open. No new toolkit benchmarks or package publication yet.
dependency: Prioritize the documented gaps and define each contract before implementation.
acceptance: Record independent contract tests, native/provider acceptance where required, current performance evidence, package dry runs and a separate release decision.

title: RPC, workflows, clustering, CLI and GraphQL
detail: Retained as future directions by user choice; no implementation or release commitment.
dependency: Separate product scope, architecture and transport/persistence contracts.
acceptance: Agree a focused proposal and measurable acceptance plan before starting implementation.

title: Cache lifecycle completion and dedicated acceptance
detail: Cache implementation and minimal core prerequisites are isolated in PR #14 against dart-effect. Website code is included; the other twelve packages remain in draft PR #13. Still unpublished.
